aarti.tek: Om, victory to you, Śrī Rāmāde; victory to you, Lord Śrī Rāmāde. Your father is Ajmal, and your mother Menāde.
aarti.pad1: He whose form is charming rides a horse; a spear shines in his hand, and he wears pearls. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Lord, you are a form of Viṣṇu, come down as an incarnation in the Kali age; gods, men and sages meditate on you and give themselves to you. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: In a moment you took away Dalajī's sorrow; you brought Bhāṇ back to life. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: You brought the merchant's boat safely across and slew the demon; in a moment you made the lake salty. ॥4॥
